purpose: Read-only numeric telemetry deadband analysis using robust delta noise and cumulative retained-value simulation.
primaryGoal: Choose a vehicle-scoped signal, understand redundant emissions, and inspect a recommended threshold's reduction, material retention and reconstruction fidelity without changing telemetry configuration.

dataSources.ownership: Existing workspace vehicle selection: URL, persisted picker and resolved fleet fallback.
dataSources.evidence: Page lines 33-37 consume the shared selection; no competing page vehicle selector.

dataSources.ownership: internal\api\signalinspect\handler.go; proto-derived catalog, not proof that samples have been ingested.
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-positive enablement; AbortSignal forwarded; standard stale time; rich descriptors reduced to names; malformed names discarded.
Vehicle and signal enablement, periodic refetch, AbortSignal forwarded; query key includes vehicle, signal and hours. No explicit row limit or workspace from/to.
dataSources.coverage: Handler defaults to 1000 rows and caps at 10000 (handler.go:102-110); ascending timestamp query with inclusive BETWEEN and LIMIT (handler.go:309-320). Response from/to are requested bounds, not observed sample extrema (handler.go:263-296). Missing database returns successful empty rows (handler.go:272-282).

dataSources.ownership: Pure feature derivation over returned raw SI measurements, not server mutation.
dataSources.behavior: At least three valid points; MAD-centered deltas, threshold candidates, cumulative retained-value simulation, quality scoring and lower-threshold tie break. signalHistorySamples.ts:14-57 filters numeric kinds and finite values, sorts and last-valid timestamp-deduplicates.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: A fatal history error produces retry surfaces in summary, chart replacement (187-190) and retention audit (244-245), plus inherited source notice. Chart replacement loses its title, subtitle and figure contract.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep each section mounted and titled; pass fatal history error/onRetry through ChartContainer's existing API and retain source-aware notices without redundant identical retry blocks.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Retention audit outer PanelTitle is repeated as the nested TelemetrySummaryBrief title at line 254 in the populated state.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use one section title while preserving the complete nested metrics, source bounds and specialist description.

findings.detail: Select uses default md, whose shared minimum height is 40px (Select.tsx:34), below the contract's preferred 44px mobile target. Actual composed size/spacing not measured.
findings.fix: Use existing lg or a reviewed density-aware variant with a verified 44px mobile target; preserve full native options and visible labels.

responsive.status: Source-only; no viewport, clipping, zoom, long-label or RTL acceptance.

strengths: Localized select label, native interaction and visible focus inherited from Select.
Chart ariaLabel and all six candidate dimensions supplied to shared fallback table.
Shared FadeIn respects reduced-motion source contract.

findings.detail: Canonical-SI explanation is a sibling Text, not the Select hint or aria-describedby target. Select's implicit ID is derived from the translated label (Select.tsx:60), so identity changes with locale.
findings.fix: Provide stable explicit control id and use existing hint prop or a stable described-by ID for the full explanation.

states.initial: Catalog skeleton; selected history skeleton/chart loading and summary suppression.
states.empty: Catalog explanatory empty state; insufficient numeric analysis null; audit distinguishes no selection from fewer than three points.
states.fatal: Source-specific QueryError retries; unaffected catalog survives history failure.
states.retained: History data stays in analysis/chart; summary retained marker covers refresh, stale and refresh failure. PageContainer dataSources inherits nonfatal source retry and offline notice.
states.unknown: Null metrics preserved; no measurements fabricated. Summary unknown covers no signal/insufficient analysis.

findings.detail: Catalog empty copy says signals populate from ingested telemetry (148-152), but the endpoint is proto-derived. This implies an unsupported remedy and does not distinguish catalog availability from historical sample coverage.
findings.fix: Describe unavailable catalog options accurately; preserve ingestion guidance only for history absence where evidence supports it.

findings.detail: Chart empty uses generic shared copy for both no selection and insufficient numeric samples, while the audit offers specific explanations. useDataState does not receive unavailable for successful empty history.
findings.fix: Pass localized emptyTitle/emptyMessage/emptyDescription appropriate to no selection, zero rows and insufficient valid numeric rows. Distinguish these cases from paused/failed queries and measured zeros.

visualIssues.detail: Two decorative panel icons use fixed text-cyan-300 (also 239) instead of neutral/theme semantic tokens. No page glow, neon, fixed-white text or gradient found in source.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted/secondary semantic icon color; preserve chartTokens data-series identity and saved chart palette choices.

visualIssues.detail: Chart ticks hardcode 10/11px sizes; threshold/count axes use default numeric presentation. Fallback columns omit kind/format, so ChartContainer.tsx:828-835 falls through to String(raw) rather than locale-aware number formatting.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse shared chart typography and current number-format helpers; assign existing column kind or specialist format functions without changing SI thresholds, retained counts or percentages.

architectureIssues.detail: History analysis is fixed to 24h and does not consume useRangeState. /signal-deadband is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:22-76); header vehicle scope remains enabled. No duplicate date control exists.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should register route and supply shared startInstant/endInstantExclusive through a typed, bounds-aware history API. Preserve 24h as appropriate default, rolling/custom/timezone semantics and current analysis coverage disclosure. Verify exclusive-end semantics: current backend uses inclusive BETWEEN.

architectureIssues.detail: Every catalog name is offered under Numeric signal although useSignals discards value_kind/unit_kind. Non-numeric signals therefore remain selectable and yield no numeric analysis. Existing typed catalog/histories normalize kind names, whereas this analyzer expects long-form ValueKind names.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse descriptor metadata to mark valid numeric choices or explain unsupported kinds, retaining access to source context. If adopting typed history, explicitly preserve analyzer kind compatibility; do not silently feed compact int/float discriminators to the current long-form parser.

architectureIssues.detail: Summary labels from/to as source bounds, but backend returns requested bounds and ascending history may truncate at default 1000. Existing description correctly disclaims full-window coverage; it must not be upgraded into an observed-coverage claim.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep requested versus returned numeric extrema distinct; expose known row-limit/coverage uncertainty using existing brief scope/provenance/description. Any new authoritative coverage metadata needs an integration-owned backend contract.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Workspace range registration and bounds-compatible analysis
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Register /signal-deadband; existing useRangeState startInstant/endInstantExclusive; typed SignalHistoryRange from/to/limit; preserve query cancellation, polling and raw-kind compatibility. Confirm backend exclusive-end policy before wiring.
requiredSharedChanges.disposition: Integration requirement, not authorization for this audit to edit shared files.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Accurate requested-window versus returned-sample bounds
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing sourceBounds {signal,from?,to?} renders source bounds; preserve unknown when absent and retained markers. Clarify supplied bounds are requested, and derive observed extrema only from valid returned samples. Reuse description/scope rather than inventing a universal coverage component.
requiredSharedChanges.disposition: Other production consumers not audited; centralized owner must reconcile wording/capability rather than adding a speculative shared component.

competingImplementations.decision: Existing parallel domain APIs, not a new implementation request. Typed catalog retains metadata and typed history supports bounds, but normalized history kinds are not drop-in compatible with the analyzer. Preserve cache, polling and discriminator contracts during any integration.
Reuse these owners; no new card, chart, stats, field, palette or overlay library needed.
